parameters.content:
## C · Notify matched users
Called by B once matching is recorded.

- Each user gets one email with their top 5 products, best fit first.
- Only the best `DEMO_LIMIT` users are emailed; the rest are recorded as `suppressed` in one SQL statement.
- Addresses are always rewritten to `GMAIL_BASE+<name>-<id>@gmail.com`. Addresses from the CSV are never used.
- A failed send is recorded as `failed` and leaves the matches pending; the batch still completes.

parameters.query:
update upload_batches
set status = 'notifying', execution_id = $2, updated_at = now()
where batch_id = $1::uuid
  and status = 'matched'
returning batch_id

with pending as (
    select user_id,
           max(score) as best_score,
           (array_agg(product_id order by score desc, product_id))[1:5] as product_ids
    from matches
    where batch_id = $1::uuid
      and notified_at is null
    group by user_id
),
ranked as (
    select *, row_number() over (order by best_score desc, user_id) as position
    from pending
),
suppressed as (
    insert into notifications (user_id, batch_id, product_ids, status)
    select user_id, $1::uuid, product_ids, 'suppressed'
    from ranked
    where position > $2::int
    on conflict (user_id, batch_id) do update set status = 'suppressed', created_at = now()
    returning user_id
),
marked as (
    update matches
    set notified_at = now()
    where batch_id = $1::uuid
      and user_id in (select user_id from suppressed)
)
select $1::uuid as batch_id, (select count(*) from suppressed)::int as suppressed

with top_matches as (
    select m.*, row_number() over (partition by m.user_id order by m.score desc, m.product_id) as position
    from matches m
    where m.batch_id = $1::uuid
      and m.notified_at is null
)
select u.user_id,
       u.name,
       u.email,
       u.monthly_income,
       u.credit_score,
       json_agg(
           json_build_object(
               'product_id', p.product_id,
               'lender', p.lender,
               'product_name', p.product_name,
               'interest_rate_min', coalesce(p.interest_rate_min,
                                             (select min(q.interest_rate_min)
                                                from loan_products q
                                               where q.lender = p.lender
                                                 and q.is_active)),
               'max_amount', p.max_amount,
               'source_url', p.source_url,
               'verdict', t.verdict,
               'score', t.score,
               'reason', t.reason
           )
           order by t.score desc, p.product_id
       ) as products
from top_matches t
join users u on u.user_id = t.user_id
join loan_products p on p.product_id = t.product_id
where t.position <= 5
group by u.user_id
order by max(t.score) desc, u.user_id

with recorded as (
    insert into notifications (user_id, batch_id, to_address, product_ids, status, ses_message_id)
    values ($1::uuid, $2::uuid, $3, $4::int[], $5, $6)
    on conflict (user_id, batch_id) do update set
        to_address = excluded.to_address,
        product_ids = excluded.product_ids,
        status = excluded.status,
        ses_message_id = excluded.ses_message_id,
        created_at = now()
    returning user_id, status
)
update matches
set notified_at = now()
where batch_id = $2::uuid
  and user_id = $1::uuid
  and (select status from recorded) = 'sent'
returning user_id

update upload_batches b
set status = 'done', updated_at = now()
where b.batch_id = $1::uuid
returning b.batch_id,
          (select count(*) from notifications n where n.batch_id = b.batch_id and n.status = 'sent')::int as sent,
          (select count(*) from notifications n where n.batch_id = b.batch_id and n.status = 'suppressed')::int
              as suppressed,
          (select count(*) from notifications n where n.batch_id = b.batch_id and n.status = 'failed')::int as failed
